intents_zh: 檢查 port 有沒有開
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
HOST="{{host}}"; PORT="{{port}}"; TIMEOUT={{timeout_s}}

end=$((SECONDS+TIMEOUT))
until bash -c "cat < /dev/tcp/$HOST/$PORT" 2>/dev/null; do
  if (( SECONDS >= end )); then
    echo "timeout $HOST:$PORT" >&2; exit 1
  fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "$HOST:$PORT is up"
